name: ACFHP annual project funding
summary: Annual request for proposals funding on-the-ground restoration and conservation of habitat for coastal, estuarine-dependent and diadromous fish along the US Atlantic coast, paid from federal National Fish Habitat Partnership funds with a required non-federal match.

eligibility.rule: Proposed actions are not mandated by a regulatory program, court order or decree
Funds not for past expenditures, realty costs, or facility operation or maintenance
Not a research project without on-the-ground habitat restoration
The project includes an outreach and education component

documents: Digital map of the project area

status.quote: Timeline: This RFP has now closed.

deadline.quote: Applications must be received by 5:00 pm Eastern time on Friday, September 25th, 2026.

geography.quote: to restore and conserve habitat necessary to support coastal, estuarine-dependent, and diadromous fish species along the U.S. Atlantic Coast.

access.quote: The Atlantic Coastal Fish Habitat Partnership (ACFHP) is requesting project applications to restore and conserve habitat necessary to support coastal, estuarine-dependent, and diadromous fish species along the U.S. Atlantic Coast.

amount.quote: We anticipate funding to support 2-3 projects ranging from$35,000 - $100,000, although funds awarded per project are typically lower than $100,000.

co_finance_required.quote: successful proposals should demonstrate a minimum 1:1 non-federal match.

effort.quote: Applications must be received by 5:00 pm Eastern time on Friday, September 25th, 2026.
Applications will be reviewed and ranked by ACFHP based on their potential to help the partnership meet its on-the-ground implementation objectives described in its Conservation Strategic Plan.

eligibility.quote: If you answer 'yes' to any of these questions, the project is ineligible for funding. Are the actions proposed mandated by a regulatory program, court order, or decree?

Will any amount of the requested funds be applied to previous expenditures? Will the requested funds be used for realty costs associated with the project? Will the requested funds be used for operation or maintenance of facilities?
ACFHP is not currently soliciting applications for research projects that do not include on-the-ground habitat restoration.
All NFHP funded projects must include an outreach/education component.

after_award.quote: provide interim and annual reports to the USFWS and ACFHP.

documents.quote: Provide digital map and pictures of the project area Each photo should be in JPG format (sent separately from the application for higher resolution)
Forms should be signed, scanned, and emailed with your application.
